## Details

<a id="set_end_figure"></a>
### [`set_end_figure`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_8cab.asm#L6) `$8CAB`

*routine*

Leftover: nothing calls this routine in part 1. It is set_end_figure of part 2 ($8e17), with all data addresses $16a lower.
Part 2 calls it in each pass of the main loop. In part 1, final_stage is always 0.
